notes: A start and finish read from the teleport graph (chk-maps run 85). The spawns stand over a teleport to the `start room` destination, where the course starts; levels level1..level31 follow, each joined by a 75x28 door teleport, and the last door goes to `slut` (Danish for end), the finish. ekstra1..3 are side rooms. Not published.

conditional_teleports.note: The anti-standing trap: touching a block renames the player `activator` after 0.09 s and back to `default` after 0.1 s; the teleports behind filter_activator fire only on that name. Run as sinking blocks.
